Over the next several months, you’re going to see a different Til You Collapse.

title: Have you ever noticed how easy it is to let one day feel bigger than it really is?
hook: Have you ever noticed how easy it is to let one day feel bigger than it really is?
caption:
Have you ever noticed how easy it is to let one day feel bigger than it really is?

One missed workout.
One restaurant meal.
One busy week.
One vacation.
One setback.

In the moment, it can feel like you've undone all of your progress.

But healthy people see things differently.

Before they react, they ask themselves:

Will this matter next week?
Next month?
Next year?

If the answer is no...

Maybe it doesn't deserve today's stress.

Healthy people don't make decisions based only on how today feels.

They think about what will help them stay healthy six months from now.

A year from now.
Ten

title: Failure is a fork in the road, not a dead end.
hook: Failure is a fork in the road, not a dead end.
caption:
Failure is a fork in the road, not a dead end.

I failed yesterday. You failed last week. We all fail.

But failure only gives you 2 options:

a. Quit & prove them right
b. Learn & prove YOURSELF right

I spent years choosing option A.

Quitting when it got hard.

Quitting when people doubted me.

All I did was prove my doubters right.

Now I choose option B.

Every rep. Every day. Every small decision.

Which one are you choosing today? 👇

Save this for the day you feel like quitting.

Kuya R
#FailureIsNotFinal #MindsetShift #DisciplineOverMotivation #KuyaRommel #FilAmFitness #LifeLessons #Bu

title: You don’t need more willpower. You need to stop breaking your own word.
hook: You don’t need more willpower. You need to stop breaking your own word.
caption:
You don’t need more willpower. You need to stop breaking your own word.

Every time you say “tomorrow” and don’t, some quiet part of you takes the note. Do it enough and your own mind stops taking your word seriously — and that’s what feels like no discipline. It isn’t. It’s a broken track record.

The fix isn’t a bigger goal. It’s one promise small enough to keep, kept on purpose. Then another. You’re not rebuilding your life. You’re rebuilding your own belief that your word means something.

Start with one.  #forgeaxe #mensmentalhealth #fatherhood #masculinity #selfimprovement
